newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba Specialty sells unit to Nalco.
newsitem.headline: Ciba Specialty sells unit to Nalco.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals Inc. said it had signed a contract with U.S.-based Nalco Chemical Co. to sell its biochemical enzyme business for pulp and paper for an undisclosed amount.
This terminates by mutual agreement Ciba Specialty's collaboration with Genencor International B.V. in this field, Ciba Specialty said in a statement.
Under the agreement Nalco will acquire worldwide exclusive rights to advanced enzyme technology to complement the company's existing polymer technologies.

Ciba's biochemical enzyme business was part of its Consumer Care division, which develops, manufactures and markets products that enhance the performance, look, care and feel of goods ranging from detergents and cosmetics to paper and textile finishes.
